bitcoin_header_source: UNRESOLVED dependency. CONFIRMED requires an independently accepted, reader-pinned Bitcoin header source (profile rev 5 §4/§7). Preferred: the owner's own synced Bitcoin Core. If external, the exact headers and how they were obtained must be saved and this dependency named. Until then R2 is at most ANCHORED_UNVERIFIED.
boundary: This is experiment history signed with PUBLIC FIXTURE keys (AUTHOR_SK = bytes([1]*32)). A timestamp over this commitment attests EXISTENCE-BEFORE-A-TIME of the commitment only -- NOT the owner's authorship and NOT the authenticity of any future release.
purpose: Frozen reproduction package for the R2 external anchor. The file to stamp is root.commitment (the 32 raw bytes of the root event_hash). Stamp THIS file; do not regenerate the journal between this freeze and the stamp.

verification.A_package_reading: Byte facts (stdlib JSON only: package_sha256, the 32-byte commitment, its equality with the root of the SAVED bytes, tip) plus a replay under separately pinned trust/root/tip by the reader from THIS package's own source_commit. Without that source tree the replay is NOT_PERFORMED, never PASS.
verification.B_source_reproducibility: Runs the generator from an exact source commit supplied by the caller (--expect-commit) and compares its output with the frozen bytes. No expectation, or no such source here -> NOT_PERFORMED, never PASS. A manifest naming a different commit is a FAIL.
verification.not_established: Neither check is an external anchor. How TODAY's in-tree reader behaves on this package is reported as a compatibility observation only: later evolution of the generator or reader never invalidates this frozen package and never requires rewriting it.
